opening.argument: The presentation centers on sending Bitcoin to a managed trading program that claims to grow users' holdings and provide interest. It says the goal is "to grow your Bitcoin for you" and offers the opportunity to become "financially free and wealthy in the future," while also stating that successful trades will produce account interest. The solicitation is reinforced by assurances concerning legal advisers, regulated brokers, free withdrawals, and no hidden costs, alongside directions to sign up and opportunities for referral and binary-pool earnings. Although it includes a historical-results disclaimer, that qualification does not outweigh the central investment and recruitment pitch.

citations.quote: The goal of MIRROR TRADING international is to grow your Bitcoin for you so that you may benefit from the long-term projected growth of Bitcoin, thus giving you the opportunity to become financially free and wealthy in the future.
Successful trades will mean that your bitcoin will grow and you will receive interest on your account.
